skill.name: female-outfit-director

skill.summary: Direct multi-outfit collage concepts into consistent short-form transformation video prompts.

content.user_title: Create Coordinated Outfit Collages and Videos
content.value_statement: Multi-outfit concepts often lose character identity and motion continuity between images and video. This skill creates linked prompts, layouts, transition timelines, and consistency constraints.
actual_capabilities: Locks supplied character, outfit, layout, camera, timing, and sound parameters.
Extracts visible appearance, clothing, accessories, and composition details from a supplied reference image.
Builds a five-character collage prompt with one central figure and four smaller outfit figures.
Plans timed outfit transitions with actions, triggers, motion directions, sound cues, and continuity rules.
Recommends outfit presets and twelve documented transition mechanisms for different visual styles.
Produces negative prompts and constraints for identity, anatomy, layout, clothing, camera, and background consistency.
limitations: It writes prompts and scripts but does not generate or edit images and videos.
Reference extraction depends on the host agent having image understanding.
Default layouts focus on one adult female character and three to six outfits.
Unclear source images can require system-completed details that may differ from the intended design.

use_cases.title: Plan a Fashion Lookbook
use_cases.description: Turn five modern outfits into a consistent collage prompt and an eight-second transformation timeline.

use_cases.title: Extend Character Reference Art
use_cases.description: Extract a character appearance and layout from an uploaded image, then plan coordinated outfit variations.

use_cases.title: Direct Hanfu Transitions
use_cases.description: Select sleeve, fan, ribbon, or figure-overlay transitions with fabric physics and precise timing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Outfit Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-outfit collage and an eight-second transformation script for one adult female character. Use a fixed 9:16 camera and recommend missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start from a simple concept without a reference image.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Style Directions
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend five distinct parameter sets for an adult female character. Include outfit logic, palette, collage layout, camera, movement style, transition mechanism, and timing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Explore options before generating complete prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Extend a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the uploaded reference image. Preserve the visible adult character, hair, accessories, clothing details, and layout while creating four compatible outfit variations and a linked video timeline.
prompt_templates.scenario: Develop a supplied character image into a transformation sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Existing Transition Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the character, outfits, camera, duration, layout, and timing from my script. Replace only the transition mechanism with three suitable alternatives and explain continuity requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve transition design without changing established creative decisions.

output_examples.input: Create a cool blue Hanfu collage with five looks and gentle transitions.
output_examples.output: Locked direction: one adult Chinese woman, five coordinated blue and white Hanfu looks, a 9:16 studio collage, and a fixed high camera. The timeline uses figure overlay and sleeve-cover transitions at four defined beats, with continuous posture and natural fabric motion.

output_examples.input: Keep my modern lookbook layout but make every transformation feel faster.
output: Option one uses full-figure sticker overlays for clear visual causality.
Option two uses page-flip silhouettes for stronger collage styling.
Option three uses step and hand-gesture beats for direct rhythmic changes.

output_examples.input: Use this reference image to create four additional outfits.
output_examples.output: The result preserves visible facial features, hair, accessories, body proportions, lighting, and composition. It adds four compatible outfits, marks uncertain details as system-completed, and links every outfit to a timed transition.

best_practices: Provide the character concept, outfit count, visual style, duration, and aspect ratio when available.
State which details are locked and allow the skill to complete only low-impact missing parameters.
Use clear reference images showing the face, hair, accessories, clothing, and body outline.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for a single portrait without a multi-outfit transformation goal.
Do not combine complex camera movement with several elaborate transitions in a short timeline.
Do not request inconsistent identity, body structure, or camera changes between outfit stages.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It produces structured image prompts, video timelines, concise video prompts, and negative constraints for compatible generation tools.

faq.question: Can it use an uploaded reference image?
faq.answer: Yes, when the host agent supports image understanding. It extracts visible character, outfit, accessory, layout, lighting, and composition details.

faq.question: Must I provide every parameter?
faq.answer: No. The skill preserves supplied details and completes low-impact gaps with documented defaults.

faq.question: What outfit styles does it support?
faq.answer: It documents Hanfu, historical Chinese, modern fashion, lookbook, and Eastern fantasy directions. User-specified styles remain locked.

faq.question: Can I change only the transition method?
faq.answer: Yes. It can preserve the character, outfits, camera, duration, layout, and timing while replacing transition triggers and related actions.

faq.question: How many outfits can it plan?
faq.answer: The default is five looks. It can adapt the layout for three to six looks when the user specifies another count.
